paragraphs.text: Teodoro Lizárraga Fonseca was designated in Designation TIJ-11-02 on 2011-09-01. Red del Horizonte Azul was linked to Designation TIJ-11-02 on 2011-09-01. Designation TIJ-11-02 occurred at Tijuana on 2011-09-01. A dock supervisor in Veracruz with prior employment in Tijuana reported that Treasury officials designated Lizárraga, the deputy of the Tijuana network known as El Cerrajero, together with the seafood exporter Mariscos Cabo Norte as parts of the Red del Horizonte Azul network. The supervisor stated that the designation was discussed openly among port workers in Tijuana because the seafood firm employed many of them.

Teodoro Lizárraga Fonseca used DEMO-TEL-00073 on 2011-09-01. Gonzalo Ferreira Luján led Red del Horizonte Azul from 2010-05-30 until 2014-11-20. Teodoro Lizárraga Fonseca was a member of Red del Horizonte Azul from 2010-05-30 until 2027-01-01. The supervisor stated that Lizárraga continued to use the telephone identifier above after the designation and that the network did not change its communications in response. The supervisor characterized Ferreira as the head of the network and Lizárraga as his deputy and a founding member.

The reporting office assesses the supervisor as having secondhand access to the Tijuana network through former colleagues. The supervisor added that the seafood firm's workers were told their jobs were safe and that the firm would continue to operate under a new name, which the supervisor could not provide. This information has not been corroborated by a second independent source at the time of writing. The reporting office continues to collect on the entities named in this report.
